description: Adobe/ISO 32000 GeoPDF viewport parsing against a real USGS US Topo sheet. `fixture` is samples/USGS_SF_North.pdf (CA_San_Francisco_North_20211230_TM_geo.pdf, public domain) cut down to a blank page of the same size that keeps page 0's three /VP viewports verbatim: the map body plus the quadrangle-location and adjoining-sheet insets. The map body's LPTS overshoot the unit square slightly (-0.00708, 1.00514) because its GPTS are a UTM rectangle sitting rotated by grid convergence on a true-north-up page. Both GeoPdfParser (Android) and GeoPDFReader (iOS) must pick the map body, and the affine fitted from its control points must put the sheet's printed 1 km UTM grid crossings on their MGRS coordinates. Grid crossing page positions were measured by rendering the real PDF at 8x, independently of either parser.
